title: slicer-cli --list-presets
description: The JSON document --list-presets [--printer NAME] prints on stdout (run_list_presets in main.cpp): every listed printer, or one printer's processes, filaments and defaults, or, with a non-zero exit code, an error. tests/test-complete-slice-path.sh checks the documents it makes against this schema, so a change to the output must change this file too.

renamed_from.description: The OrcaSlicer engines: the old name --printer gave, which names this printer now.

printer_model.description: Empty when the preset states none.

default_process.description: The process a slice with only --printer-preset takes.

default_filaments.description: The filament a slice with only --printer-preset takes; empty when none fits.

defaults_replaced.description: Sentences: a default the printer states that the desktop replaces, and with what.

processes.description: The process presets this printer can use.

filaments.description: The filament presets this printer can use.

default_bed_type.description: The plate type a slice with this printer takes.

error.description: A non-zero exit code: -1 CLI_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR (the presets did not load) or -5 CLI_CONFIG_FILE_ERROR (no printer by that name).

close_names.description: Printer names close to the one given.
